leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of , Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fifteenth season of , Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Three Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies DVD sets were released between 2013-2014 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. The first sets contain two discs each, while the third set contains four discs. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Set 1===
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Set 1 was released on September 10, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 
===Set 2===
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Set 2 was released on December 3, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 
===Set 3===
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - Set 3 was released on March 18, 2014. It contains four discs with 25 episodes across them combined.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon: BW Rival Destinies - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Black and White: Rival Destinies Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on March 15, 2022 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with 49 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000088426 It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.
